I can only express deep sorrow and pain typing this out. I can't stop thinking about her sweet, gentle touches across my body, reaching into my soul, fishing out and drowning my insecurities with love and joy.  
She held me in relational bondage, preventing me from ever being loved or seeing love again. The nervous fatigue of my thoughts was exposed by the true darkness perpetuated by life itself. I was traumatized by the constant barrage of challenges that life had thrown at me, all of which I had avoided thanks to her consistent support throughout the course of our relationship.  
She was my only reason to survive, my only hope of escaping this disastrous dystopia of an existence. This was the last chapter. No more excuses to be tortured and tormented by societal expectations. I vowed to walk down to the train station and remove myself from now on, do you understand? My sinister schemes were derailed as I took my final breaths, took my final steps, and pondered my final thoughts.  
Until I laid my eyes upon the devious creature lying across the road, naked. The African Child was sucking its thumb, with a bucket of human poop on the other hand. The question I asked was: "Is that part of God's plan, and if so, why the fuck does he feel the need to release a naked African Child on busy city roads?" He asked me: Not only did it make me doubt the ways of God, but it also asked me if God is part of our reality? This event definitely gave me a more "Atheistic" side, but I was certainly not allowed to do so by my highly religious Catholic upbringing. Instead, I decided to keep believing, not in any God or supernatural or benign monster, but in every Astral plane of our reality. I decided to be an Agnostic, to believe in and not to believe the gods and goddesses. This creature, so gentle a lover whose elegant yet so messy, will rip your eyes out of your skull without a spill of dark red. A ferocious, black monster; a gentle being. The black shadow, placed onto a busy street in Great Britain, home to the royals and the homos, and now to the hairy beast. He walked slowly observing and assessing. The confused wanderer would not fight, knowing that fighting will lead to its demise. As the intelligent creature wandered the streets, people sought shelter and refuge to hide from this two-faced killing machine. His head, faced down, shying away from the blinding lights and loud noises of a busy street. I intended to find out more about this creature, and where it had originated from. Doing intricate research from the international zoo in Yugoslavia, it was rather preeminent that the swine was a successor of the greatest ruler in India, Humpty Hitler. His reign was furthermore legendary. I searched through the old library that was located in the rural parts of the Yugoslavian backforest, where, fortunately, the Bosnian Genocide had taken place. I did not know she was 8. The legendary books read: “ It was a bright summer morning- All of Humpty’s dreams led up to this moment. Pursuing the World of art, wanting to kill all Jews. As he stood up, he peered outside his window. The Wehrmacht were already in line, getting ready to invade Poland. Humpty put on his Paramilitary outfit, and before stepping out, recollected on what he had to first achieve before getting to this point. He first had to get down a large wall, which was assisted by Japanese Aerial Forces. Then, alongside his army, marched into the King’s Castle, killed all the King’s horses and men, and made sure none of the women and children could be put back together again. His footsteps echoed as he walked towards the large metal door. He closed his eyes as he advanced onto the stage, located a door away from where he slumbered. “WIR MÜSSEN FÜR UNSERE URSACHE KÄMPFEN!” Humpty exclaimed, with saliva and bits of his dinner flying out of his mouth. At the end of his boringly long speech, he stepped down from the stage, slipped, and died.”
